scope: Six new primary papers; one author implementation; official sources and community counterevidence incorporated from sibling MCP research. No model execution.

papers.title: AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
papers.data: 379 SWE-rebench tasks; 1052 corrected SFT trajectories; SWE-Gym RL
papers.budget: Training 50 environment steps/32K; main evaluation no inference cost cap, three-run averages; budget curves $0.10–4.00
papers.limitation: Joint training gain, not prompt-only gain; no author code release verified.

papers.title: SWE-MeM: Learning Adaptive Memory Management for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
papers.budget: 32K; 500 steps unless marked 150; trained 30B average77 steps/0.91M cumulative tokens
papers.result: 30B Base 256K/32K 51.6/38.6; SFT/RL 58.8/60.2. Workflow-only58.4 uses proprietary inference assistance.
papers.limitation: Long-horizon 500-step setting; no public author implementation verified.

papers.title: CoACT: Action-Preserving Observation Compression for Coding Agents
papers.data: 200 sampled SWE-bench Verified evaluation tasks; Qwen compressor data 50 SWE-smith tasks/4866 examples
papers.budget: mini-swe-agent; no 300-second condition reported; author current config step_limit0
papers.result: Qwen57.0→60.5, 3.795M→2.428M tokens; DeepSeek76.5→75.0; Gemini73.5→77.5; no-AP50.0; offline-only56.0
papers.limitation: Separate neural compressor unavailable under single designated model interpretation; no uniform cross-model score gain.

papers.title: Coherence Collapse: Diagnosing Why Code Agents Fail After Reaching the Right Code
papers.data: 16758 trajectories across SWE-bench Verified500 and PolyBench382, 3 scaffolds
papers.budget: Each scaffold default budget; no common wall-clock cap
papers.result: Qwen Coder30B66.7% Edit-Quality in231 classified failures; 5 exact intermediate patches restored5/5; GPT5 consensus66→69,p=.08
papers.limitation: Intermediate exact cases selected with reference patches; multi-model consensus not single-model deployable evidence.

papers.title: More with Less: An Empirical Study of Turn-Control Strategies for Efficient Coding Agents
papers.data: 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks sampled proportionally by repo
papers.budget: TRAE; dynamic25→50/50→75 denote baseline-turn percentiles; single runs; caching disabled
papers.result: Dynamic50→75 vs fixed75 solved Claude71→70,Gemini65→64,GPT57→59; cost -13.42/-24.18/-12.27%
papers.limitation: Cost advantage not universal accuracy dominance; API costs and turns not Gemma wall time.

papers.title: Beyond Resolution Rates: Behavioral Drivers of Coding Agent Success and Failure
papers.data: 9374 leaderboard trajectories on500 SWE-bench Verified tasks;8 frameworks
papers.budget: Observational across submissions; no common inference or training budget
papers.result: Within416 contested tasks successful44.0 steps vs failed39.6;263 tasks success longer;10/12 universally-failed simple-patch cases architectural-level errors
papers.limitation: Within-task controls difficulty but not agent identity; association not causal instruction to delay editing.
